messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21-2: Team Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2026-06-08] standup/atlas/2026-06-08: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Marcus.

- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: Marcus is on call for the Boreal team to start the year.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02-3: Cinder has moved to the third floor.
- [2025-08-12] standup/boreal/2025-08-12: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Marcus hands the pager to Lena Fischer.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for the Atlas team goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, Ledger is owned by team Atlas.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz.
- [2026-01-29] handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the feature flag service moves from Cinder to team Dune. Yuki walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-05-14] standup/atlas/2025-05-14: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Tomasz.
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-event-bus: Boreal handed the bus to the Dune team today; Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz Nowak.
- [2025-01-07] standup/boreal/2025-01-07: Boreal roster: Lena and Marcus Oyelaran.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-12-31] standup/atlas/2025-12-31: The Atlas team noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-19] standup/atlas/2025-02-19: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Priya Raman for anything this cycle, not Tomasz. Priya Raman runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: Reminder from Boreal: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Lena.
- [2025-02-10] standup/boreal/2025-02-10: Lena has the Boreal pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer: Handover: as of today image-resizer moves from Dune to Cinder. Farah Haddad walked Yuki through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-09-24] standup/boreal/2025-09-24: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena today.
- [2025-05-21] standup/boreal/2025-05-21: Lena picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Marcus today.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-07-09] standup/boreal/2025-07-09: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Atlas owns billing-api. Atlas looks after the flags service.
- [2026-04-21] handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags: The feature flag service has a new home: the Atlas team. The Dune team kept it until today.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday.

Question: Which team was Marcus on before moving to Atlas?
